contamination.label: Flagship expertise
contamination.title: Clean oil is a controlled equipment asset.
contamination.body: Moisture and solid particles accelerate component wear. Get2Gear combines reservoir protection, offline and bypass filtration, sampling and condition monitoring into one contamination-control system.

systems.label: Product systems
systems.title: Protect. Filter. Verify.
systems.note: Des-Case and RMF Systems solutions for protecting, cleaning and monitoring industrial fluids.

breathers.title: Protect reservoirs from moisture and particles
breathers.body: Breathers are selected around airflow, environmental exposure, reservoir type and operating duty — from compact units to severe-duty industrial series.

filtration.title: Offline and bypass filtration
filtration.body: RMF Systems filtration circuits help maintain a target fluid cleanliness level without stopping the primary equipment.

monitoring.title: Monitor and verify the outcome
monitoring.body: Control starts with measurement. We select tools for representative sampling, particle counting and fluid-condition observation in the live process.

results.label: Field experience
results.title: Contamination control for a mining operation.
results.body: Des-Case breathers and solutions for lubricant storage, transfer and cleaning were implemented at a mining site.
results.disclaimer: One integrated circuit connects reservoir protection, filtration and oil-condition monitoring in daily operation.

results.caption: Des-Case and RMF Systems contamination-control solutions

economics.label: Reliability economics
economics.title: Measure the cost of downtime, not only the filter.
economics.body: We compare failure risk, oil consumption, component life and service cost. Each calculation uses site-specific inputs — without universal promises or unsupported percentages.
